custodian: Direction du cadastre et de la géoinformation, État de Vaud; City of Lausanne viewer
scope: The official Canton of Vaud viewer and City of Lausanne viewer document cadastral parcel publication. GeoAdmin's public CadastralWebMap identify service returned two Lausanne polygons in a bounded window.

queries.query: Lausanne official cadastral map parcel GIS Vaud cadastre
queries.outcome: Official Vaud cadastral viewer, City of Lausanne map, and Vaud geoservices pages found.

queries.query: Lausanne cadastre officiel plan cadastral géoportail parcelles
queries.outcome: Official French-language parcel-localisation page and City viewer found; parcel layer and update statements documented.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200; current JavaScript/configuration retrieved. It identifies Vaud ArcGIS infrastructure and official cadastral viewer configuration.
HTTP 200; public viewer bootstrap/config retrieved. No credentials or private token used.
HTTP 200; layer schema exposed fields including id, number, egris_egrid, ak and identnd.
HTTP 200; bounded anonymous point identify at Lausanne map coordinates returned two polygon features in EPSG:2056. Response retained in ignored tmp evidence; safe sample retained separately.
HTTP 400; endpoint does not expose a vector-table query route in this API form. This was not treated as service absence.

schemaAndCrs.identityEvidence: The identify response returned egris_egrid values CH698375964586 and CH784783457688 alongside service feature ids 1121681 and 1131127.

safeFieldAllowlist: parcel number only as source metadata
uncertainty: Only a small Lausanne window was queried; no citywide extent enumeration was attempted. The exact WUP point was not moved to force a hit. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
reviewDisposition: Packet is complete as a research record. Keep runtime integration held until serial review independently qualifies a real adapter and safe EGRID mapping.
